features: 30W HD Bluetooth Speaker: Enjoy crystal-clear, room-filling sound with a powerful 30W output—perfect for house parties, karaoke nights, or outdoor gatherings.
Wireless Karaoke Mic Included: Sing your heart out anytime with the included wireless karaoke microphone, ideal for duets, parties, and family fun.
5 Hours Playtime: Keep the music going longer with a high-capacity battery that delivers up to 5 hours of non-stop entertainment on a single charge.
RGB Ring LED Light: Add vibrant ambience to your music sessions with dynamic multi-color RGB lights that sync beautifully with your beats.
Echo & Volume Control: Fine-tune your karaoke experience using the built-in echo and volume controls on the mic for a perfect vocal balance.
Type-C Fast Charging Port: Charge faster and smarter with a modern Type-C interface for quick power-ups and universal compatibility.
Easy Portability with Handle Support: Compact design with built-in handle makes it effortless to carry your Bluetooth speaker anywhere—indoors or outdoors.
